fields.label: Authentication Provider
fields.description: Specify which AWS credentials chain to use.

fields.label: Assume Role ARN
fields.description: Optional. Specifying the ARN of a role will ensure that the selected authentication provider is used to assume the role rather than the credentials directly. Note the key casing: the backend struct tag is `assumeRoleARN` (grafana-aws-sdk awsds.AWSDatasourceSettings), but this schema declares `assumeRoleArn` to match what the config editor (@grafana/aws-sdk ConnectionConfig) reads and writes. encoding/json falls back to a case-insensitive tag match, so the backend loads either spelling correctly; `assumeRoleArn` is required here so the editor can read the value back.

validations.message: When set, must be a valid IAM role ARN, e.g. arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/MyRole

fields.label: Region
fields.description: Backend-only. Second region field on awsds.AWSDatasourceSettings that the config editor never renders — awsds Load copies defaultRegion into it when it is empty or the literal 'default'. Set defaultRegion instead.

fields.label: Assume Role ARN (legacy casing)
fields.description: Backend-only. Mirrors the upper-camel-case `assumeRoleARN` json tag on awsds.AWSDatasourceSettings that encoding/json promotes independently of the `assumeRoleArn` field above. The config editor never renders or reads this spelling; set jsonData_assumeRoleArn instead. This entry exists only so the schema stays in sync with the promoted struct tag.

relationships.description: AWS access key pair — supplied together when authType is 'keys'
STS assume-role parameters — external ID is only meaningful when assumeRoleArn is set
Grafana Assume Role per-datasource external ID — grafanaExternalId is only meaningful when usePerDatasourceExternalId is true
HTTP proxy parameters — proxyUrl and proxyUsername only apply when proxyType is 'url'

instructions.msg: Six authentication values are stored in jsonData.authType. The five editor-selectable ones are: 'default' (AWS SDK Default — the default credential chain), 'keys' (Access & secret key — puts accessKey/secretKey in secureJsonData), 'credentials' (Credentials file — optionally provide jsonData.profile), 'ec2_iam_role' (Workspace IAM Role — no extra credentials needed), and 'grafana_assume_role' (Grafana Assume Role — Grafana Cloud only; visible only when the awsDatasourcesTempCredentials feature toggle is on and grafana-x-ray-datasource is in the ConnectionConfig allow-list, which it is). The sixth is 'arn' (deprecated legacy value; the backend maps it to 'default').
